journey.name: PreserveGameState
journey.description: Verifies that the Start screen shows a leaderboard after a completed game, and that basic game flow (start, answer, next round) works correctly after the feature is introduced. Process-death restore is verified by unit tests; this journey covers the happy-path user-facing acceptance criteria observable via UI.

actions.action: Verify the Start screen is visible, showing the 'Puck Trivia' title and a 'Regular Season' button.
Tap the 'Regular Season' button. Verify the trivia question screen appears showing a 'Score:' label and a 'Lives:' label.
Verify a hockey trivia question is displayed above several player answer buttons.
Tap the first player answer button. Verify that answer feedback appears — either a correct or incorrect color change on the selected button — and that the 'Next' button becomes visible.
Tap the 'Next' button. Verify a new trivia question is displayed with the score or lives updated as appropriate.
Continue answering questions incorrectly until the game ends. Verify the Game Over screen appears showing a final score and a 'Play Again' button.

Tap the 'Play Again' button. Verify the Start screen appears again. Verify that a 'High Scores' leaderboard section is now visible on the Start screen, showing at least one score entry from the completed game.
